text:
Ava (marketing lead): Quick sync on tri-mode pages + webinar. Need concise, engineer-first copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private and a webinar CTA that drives qualified leads. Drafts due Tue.
Ravi (growth): Goal = use benchmark narrative to lift signups and qualify inbound. One hero + one subhead per mode, max words constraints.
Maya (product): Keep tradeoffs explicit: Hosted = fastest time-to-value; Dedicated = reserved capacity & SLAs; Private = VPC/on-prem + compliance. Add 2 measurable claims under each hero.
Jon (content): Drafting tone: "confident, engineer-friendly". Rough hero options:
- Hosted: "Launch fast with our Hosted API." subhead: "Minutes to integrate, pay-as-you-go, curated models."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for production LLMs." subhead: "Reserved GPUs, autoscale policies, SLA-backed."
- Private: "Inference where you need it." subhead: "VPC & on-prem options with KMS integrations."
Lena (demand gen): Webinar promo: title "Real benchmarks: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private"; one-line: "See latency, cost, and migration patterns from real workloads." CTA variants: "Reserve your seat" / "Get benchmark PDF". Put CTA above fold on tri-mode landing.
Ravi (growth): Inbound routing rules: form -> HubSpot. If company_size >= 200 OR enterprise checkbox checked -> AE queue; else SDR. Tag campaign=tri_mode_bench and add UTM params.
FormBot: HubSpot mapping confirmed. Example payload: `POST /hooks/hubspot {email: '{{email}}', campaign: 'tri_mode_bench', primary_use_case: '{{use_case}}'}`
Jon (content): Add microcopy beside CTA: "Watch live + get the full benchmark PDF". Also prepare two hero variants for A/B; add `hero_variant` query flag for QA.
Maya (product): Ops will provide p50/p95 latency for Hosted sample, tokens/sec for Dedicated typical throughput, cert list for Private. Ill send numbers by Tue 5pm.
Ava (marketing lead): Editorial rules: hero <= 10 words, subhead <= 14 words. Keep jargon minimal, outcome oriented.
Lena (demand gen): Launch post cadence: announcement -> benchmark teaser -> webinar reminder. Copy example: "Join our live benchmark: real latency & cost tradeoffs across Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Register for the webinar."
Ravi (growth): Tracking: append `?utm_source=launch_post&utm_campaign=tri_mode_bench&utm_medium=social`. Ensure OG tags reflect hero A/B.
Jon (content): Action: push hero/subhead drafts + CTA copy to staging by Tue noon. Will drop in #marketing-drafts and ping here.
Maya (product): Request: add "Primary use case" single-choice field on form (chat, embeddings, reranking, other) to help segmentation.
Ravi (growth): We'll map that to `primary_use_case` property in HubSpot.
Ava (marketing lead): Final: avoid fluffy positioning. Keep it technical and clear for engineers & platform teams. QA Fri AM. :white_check_mark:
